messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: GLM (Generalized linear model) for stat_smooth
parts:
Dear group members,

In the Methods options in stat_smooth there is no option for glm (generalized linear model).  Is it possible to apply stat_smooth for a glm?

Best,

Manuel

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: Re: GLM (Generalized linear model) for stat_smooth
parts:
Hi Manuel:
I found the example below by typing ?stat_smooth

qplot(Age, as.numeric(Kyphosis) - 1, data = kyphosis) +
  stat_smooth(method="glm", family="binomial")
qplot(Age, as.numeric(Kyphosis) - 1, data=kyphosis) +
  stat_smooth(method="glm", family="binomial", formula = y ~ ns(x, 2))

 
Felipe D. Carrillo
Supervisory Fishery Biologist
Department of the Interior
US Fish & Wildlife Service
California, USA
